title: Nontrivial automorphisms of every APN function
summary: Determine whether every APN function has a nontrivial full graph automorphism group.

formal_statement.body: For every $n$ and every APN function $F:\mathbb F_2^n\to\mathbb F_2^n$, is $$|\operatorname{Aut}(F)|>1?$$ Prove universal nontriviality of the source-defined full graph automorphism group, or construct an APN function with a trivial automorphism group.

scope.domain: Full graph automorphism groups of APN vectorial Boolean functions
assumptions: $\operatorname{Aut}(F)$ is the source-defined full automorphism group
scope.unresolved_remainder: Prove nontriviality for every APN function in every dimension, or give an APN function whose full automorphism group is trivial.

citations.label: Beierle--Brinkmann--Leander, APN automorphism conjecture
citations.locator: Conjecture 1 and Conclusion, journal pp. 4868 and 4874

progress.summary: The first clause of Conjecture 1 asserts that every APN function has a nontrivial full automorphism group.
